sentences.text: Anticipatory Bail Application No. 1239 Of 2023
Mansi Mangesh Dalvi ... Appli

v/s.
 The State of Maharashtra ....

Resp
 Ms. Manisha Devkar for the Applicant.
 Mr. R.M. Pethe, App for the State.
Mr. Patil, Api, Kandivali Police Station, present.

Coram: Smt. Anuja Prabhudessai, J.
Dated : 26th April, 2023.

This is an Application under section 438 of Cr.P.C. filed by the aforesaid Applicant
apprehending her arrest in C.R.No.204/2023 registered with Kandivali Police
Station, Mumbai for offences punishable under sections 406, 420, 506 of the Indian
Penal Code.
2. Heard learned counsel for the Applicant and learned APP for the State.
I have perused the records and considered the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the respective parties.
3. The aforesaid crime was registered pursuant to the FIR lodged by one Chalian Sediwel.
The facts narrated in the FIR prima facie reveals P.H. Jayani 12 ABA1239.2023.doc that the Applicant and the first informant were working in the same office and were known to each other.
The first informant has stated that he had given money to the Applicant from time to time to meet hospital and other household expenses.
It is stated that the Applicant has not returned the money.
Hence, the FIR came to be lodged against the Applicant for cheating and misappropriation.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The FIR prima facie does not show the essential ingredients of cheating within the meaning of section 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
Considering the nature of accusations, no case is made out for custodial interrogation.

Hence, the Application is allowed on the following terms and conditions :-
(a) In the event of arrest of the Applicant in C.R.No.204/2023 registered with Kandivali Police Station, Mumbai, she shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount ;
(b) The Applicant shall report to the Investigating Officer for two days i.e., on 30th April, 2023 and 01st May, 2023 between 11:00 a.m. to 02:00 p.m. P.H. Jayani 12 ABA1239.2023.doc (c) The Applicant shall not interfere with the complainant and the other witnesses and shall not tamper with the evidence or attempt to influence or contact the complainant, witnesses or any person concerned with the case in any manner ;
(d) The Applicant shall keep the Investigating Officer informed of his current address and mobile contact numbers, and/or change of residence or mobile details, if any,
from time to time.
5. The Application stands disposed of.
(SMT. ANUJA PRABHUDESSAI, J.)
